source: Authored for GenomeVault (D-040 part 1). Pairs chosen in the style of the ISMP list of confused drug names, restricted to names in or next to drug_names.json. Synthetic project data, not a clinical reference (I1).
note: A typed word within suggest()'s distance limit of any name in a group is always 'ask', never 'assumed'. The other names in that group are offered as choices too. Names not in drug_names.json (e.g. clozapine) are real drugs GenomeVault has no tables for: a word that spells one exactly gets no suggestion, and a near miss lists it among the choices so the user is never steered to a covered look-alike.
